standout_why: I opened four of the result pages: itechguides '15 Best' (cited), deskgearhq (cited), theofficejournal's 15.6-inch page and workcocoon's 15.6-inch page. They do hold part of it: itechguides gives the Duex Max DS a rough fit of 14 inches or larger and carries an Amazon sidebar listing (ZUMWALT P7) saying M1/M2/M3 MacBooks need a driver cable; deskgearhq states DisplayPort Alt Mode for all five of its picks. ChatGPT's own answer already carries the generic MacBook and DisplayLink warning. The finding stays at 1 until the maker cells for the FOPO S10, Duex Max DS and Fold 15.6 are read.
decides: It confirms the shape of the answer but does not change a pick today. The only maker-document cell I read is the ASUS ZenScreen MB169CK: a freestanding 15.6-inch screen with no lid-fit limit, fed by one DisplayPort Alt Mode USB-C port or mini HDMI. The dual 15.6-inch FOPO S10 and the attachable Duex Max DS can be ranked on compatibility only once their maker fit range and Mac statements are read. deskgearhq's line that one USB-C cable drives both Trio 3 Pro panels leaves out the driver condition in Dealectric's existing record (one cable for both screens only with Mobile Pixels' display driver); I did not re-read that record's source today.
